findings.issue: Level-chip palette for depth 2: the tree renders «قسم» with WChipVariant.Success (a green pill, visible in both the light and dark host screenshots), while the A05 preview shows the «قسم» chip in the same neutral/grey as «وحدة». Only «هيئة» (green) and «دائرة» (blue) are coloured there. A purely visual nuance — the chip is present, sized and placed exactly as in the preview.
findings.fix: Either change WTree.DefaultLevelVariant's depth-2 arm from WChipVariant.Success to WChipVariant.Neutral (src/Wakeel.Design/Components/WTree.razor, line 115), or leave the default and let A05 pass LevelVariantAt="d => d switch { 0 => Primary, 1 => Info, _ => Neutral }" when it is built. No change needed if the four-colour depth ramp is the intended design-system rule.

findings.issue: Arrow/Home/End/Space keystrokes are not prevented from reaching the browser, so navigating the tree with the keyboard also scrolls the page under it (confirmed in the running host: the tree's active row moves correctly, but the gallery scrolls with it). The code comment documents this as the deliberate cost of avoiding a Tab trap, since Blazor's @onkeydown:preventDefault is evaluated at render time and cannot be scoped to the consumed keys.
findings.fix: If the scrolling is judged worse than the extra plumbing: add a tiny handler in the design-system JS (src/Wakeel.Design/wwwroot/js) that calls preventDefault on ArrowUp/ArrowDown/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End/Space for elements matching [role=tree], leaving Tab and Ctrl+F untouched, and attach it once from WTree's OnAfterRenderAsync. Otherwise keep as is — the current behaviour is safe, just noisier.

findings.issue: The Hint line keeps rendering while the tree is in the no-match state: with a search that matches nothing the pane shows «لا عنصر بهذا الاسم» and, underneath it, the reorder-handle guidance «مقبض الترتيب في نهاية كل صف...» although no row (and therefore no handle) is on screen. Reproduced in the host.
findings.fix: In WTree.razor line 23, guard the hint on the tree actually having rows: @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Hint) && _roots.Count > 0).

findings.issue: The gallery section heading is Ar.Tree.Label («شجرة العناصر»); the specification names the section «الشجرة». The text is correct Arabic and no screen depends on it, so this is naming only.
findings.fix: Add a dedicated gallery heading constant (e.g. Ar.Tree.Demo.SectionTitle = "الشجرة") and pass it to WSectionHeader Title instead of reusing the tree's accessible name — the accessible label and the section heading are different jobs.

MINOR NON-FINDINGS observed while reading: SelectAsync writes to the Selected parameter for optimistic highlighting (standard @bind pattern, superseded on the parent's next render); ToggleAsync/SetExpandedAsync call Rebuild() before the bound Expanded round-trips, which is immediately superseded by OnParametersSet; a caller that passes Expanded without ExpandedChanged gets inert carets, which is the documented controlled contract. None warrants a change. The «بلا رئيس معيّن» state is rendered as amber text with a ⚠ icon rather than a WChip pill — that is what the A05 preview shows, so it is correct despite the spec wording "state chip".
